title: Arab Astronomical Forum 2024
excerpt: The Arab Union for Astronomy and Space Sciences is pleased to invite you to attend the “Arab Astronomical Forum 2024,” featuring: – Dr. Muhammad Al-Assiri, President of the Syrian Astronomical Society and Vice President…
body:
The Arab Union for Astronomy and Space Sciences is pleased to invite you to attend the “Arab Astronomical Forum 2024,” featuring:

– Dr. Muhammad Al-Assiri, President of the Syrian Astronomical Society and Vice President of the Arab Union for Astronomy and Space Sciences.
– Engineer Osama Fathy, Chairman of the Egyptian Society for Astronomy, and a member of the union.
– Mr. Mohammed Awad Al-Obaidi, Astronomical Observer and Photographer, and a member of the union.

The event will take place on:
📅 Thursday, July 11, 2024
🕕 6:00 PM Mecca Time
📍 In-person at the headquarters of the Arab Union located in Amman, Jordan – Al-Gardens – behind Abu Jbara Restaurants.

And via Zoom:
AUASS is inviting you to a scheduled Zoom meeting.
